title: Weak two-function hypercontractivity on a single bit
statement:
Let $1 \le p \le 2$ and $1 \le q \le 2$, and set $\rho = \sqrt{(p-1)(q-1)}$. Then for
any two Boolean functions $f, g : \{0,1\}^1 \to \bbr$ on a single bit,
\[
\inn{f, T_\rho g} \;\le\;
\bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^p\,]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\,\abs{g}^q\,]\bigr)^{1/q},
\]
where $T_\rho$ is the noise operator, $\E[\cdot]$ is the expectation, and
$\inn{\cdot,\cdot}$ is the $L^2$ inner product, all taken with respect to the uniform
measure on $\{0,1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: f, g are Boolean functions on one bit
replaced:
